entities.name: Biracazir
entities.description: Wolf mount of the ledev wolfrider Fonn Zunich on Ravnica, sired by Voja; became protector of Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Fonn Zunich
entities.description: Ledev wolfrider who rode Biracazir and used Saint Bayul's green gem to link Biracazir's life force to Mat'Selesnya.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Ancient vampire whose return Biracazir witnessed; tried to drain Mat'Selesnya's life energy.

entities.name: Mat'Selesnya
entities.description: Selesnyan parun nearly killed by Szadek and restored with help of Biracazir's lifeforce.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Site of the Decamillennial convocation, protected afterwards by Biracazir.

entities.name: Saint Bayul
entities.description: Source of the green gem connecting an individual's mind to the Conclave.

entities.name: Decamillennial convocation
entities.description: Gathering at Vitu-Ghazi during which Szadek returned.

events.summary: Biracazir attacked Szadek at the Decamillennial convocation and was seriously wounded.
Szadek drained Mat'Selesnya to the brink of death; Fonn used the green gem so Biracazir's lifeforce restored her strength.
events.quote: Biracazir's lifeforce helped to recreate Mat'Selesnya's strength.

events.summary: Biracazir remained at Vitu-Ghazi as its protector and overseer.
events.quote: Biracazir remained at Vitu-Ghazi as its protector and overseer.

relations.quote: Biracazir was the wolf mount of the ledev wolfrider Fonn Zunich on Ravnica

relations.note: Szadek attempted to drain her life energy.
relations.quote: When Szadek attempted to drain Mat'Selesnya 's life energy
